title: Timetable vs Reality
topic: Planning the perfect study timetable instead of starting to study
caption_ig:
Sunday night me: "From tomorrow, 5 AM, 12 hours, full syllabus in 30 days!" 💪
Monday 9 AM me: still colouring the perfect timetable… in 4 colours 🖍️☕
Sound familiar? The best timetable is the one you start today.
ప్లాన్ తక్కువ, చదువు ఎక్కువ! 📚
